sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.24
- Clicking a wine partway down the store no longer flashes the page content below the store while the wine loads, and the page lands just below a sticky header instead of under it.
- Refreshing the page, or pressing Back from a wine, returns to the same spot in the store listing.
- Buy buttons for club and member-only wines now offer "Sign in to buy" to visitors who are not signed in, and bring them back to the same page once they are.
- Buy buttons can show a quantity picker that follows the wine's minimum and maximum purchase amounts. Turn it on per button with qty="1" on the shortcode.
- A signed-in customer who is not yet eligible for a wine can be sent to your club page from the button, using the new join link setting.
- On Squarespace stores, Checkout from the cart drawer now works from pages outside the store, and tells the shopper where to go when the store page is not set up.
